description: This PHP file defines a form processing class 'ProjectPostForm' used for creating and saving project posts within the Goteo platform. It handles form creation, including fields for title, date, images, text, media, comments permission, and publish status, as well as saving logic that processes images, filters text, and interacts with the model to persist data.

classes.name: ProjectPostForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating and saving project posts, handling form building and data persistence.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the form with fields for title, date, images, text, media, comments permission, and publish status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes form data, manages image uploads/removals, filters text content based on permissions, and saves the post model.
